notes: Detection is the level-overlap comparison, not a heuristic: the certified cone-overlap outcome of two consecutive subdivision levels (the F-C6 ConeOverlapRecord, recorded per depth from CFP-001 interval-cone arithmetic) is compared EXACTLY; non-shrink = the cones still overlap at the later recorded depth (no strictly-positive certified shrink), no epsilon, no tuning knob (ssi.rs::cone_overlap_did_not_shrink). Consumer call shape: new ssi.rs route_stagnation(records, CascadeClassifyInput{system,graph,minors,tsys,b}, budget) reads the two consecutive recorded levels in fixed order and, on non-shrink, hands the pair to the LANDED cascade through its published classify_box entry verbatim — the cascade internals were NOT widened; the scope-decision-2 one-additive-forward clause was not exercised because classify_box is already public (cascade.rs production is untouched; only its test module gained the 3 tests). Fail-closed: classify_box's typed ContactVerdict::Unresolved residual is carried verbatim (a pair the cascade refuses keeps the typed Unresolved with its cell; the F5 A2-parabola near-tangent pair driven through the A1 classifier is the test's refusing pair); a hard classify refusal (invalid box / unavailable hull) is carried as the typed CascadeRefused(TangencyRefusal) — never a panic, never a guess, never a silent downgrade. Deviations/notes: (1) ssi.rs contains no pre-existing literal subdivision/cone budget-burn LOOP to delete — A1's single 'unresolved' line is a doc comment, so the old-budget-burn-arm replacement is delivered as the new consumer API and pinned by tests rather than by editing a live legacy arm; (2) the RESULT template's anchors_verified A3:8 is not reachable: fixtures.rs is read-only and its F-C6 count is and stays 5 (measured, matches the packet anchor expect); (3) verification: cargo test -p truck-certified --lib green (664 passed incl. the 3 new tests stagnation_routes_to_cascade_fc6 / cascade_verdict_replaces_budget_burn / stagnation_detection_deterministic) and cargo check -p truck-shapeops green; both edited files are fmt-clean and clippy-clean, BUT the crate-wide 'cargo fmt --check -p truck-certified' and 'cargo clippy -p truck-certified --all-targets -- -D warnings' still fail on PRE-EXISTING drift in untouched files (kernel/claims.rs, kernel/engine.rs, kernel/tier2.rs, formal/*, tests/construct_*.rs under rustfmt 1.9.0-stable / clippy 1.97) — identical failure reproduced with our edits stashed (baseline), and none of the diagnostics reference ssi.rs or cascade.rs.
